neighbours.label: the military or civil rank 'Lieutenant' (and its abbreviation 'Lt.') used as a title, as against other ranks and offices
fire: Officials met with Lieutenant Colonel Ann Pierce to review the base closure.
The speech was given by Lieutenant Governor Tom Reyes at the state fair.
Army Lt. Gen. Mark Ellis took command of the eastern division.
Reporters later spoke with Lt. Gov. Sara Klein about the budget vote.
A letter from Lieutenant Commander Peter Hale was read at the memorial.
Witnesses said Lieutenant Davis ordered the convoy to turn back.
During the inquiry, Lt. Ramirez described the night of the fire.
The award was presented to Lieutenant Grace Moon of the coast guard.
